g.text: UAV on dock and in airspace,

svg.text: Generated by tools/figures/pages3d_readme.py from the pages in docs/3d and the checks that open them. The pages show concept geometry and synthetic results: design aids with no evidence credit (sim/README.md, evidence gate).

g.text: Terms: 3D = three-dimensional · CI = continuous integration (the automated checks GitHub runs on every change) · CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout) · KB = kilobyte, a file size of 1,024

bytes · S3-nnn = 3D hazard scene (sim/scenes3d) · SHA-256 = a cryptographic hash used to pin a downloaded file · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-M1 = piloted walker · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
